about.title: About this project
about.intro_1: The Austria Population Tracker visualises how Austria's population has changed since 2002 — across Bundesländer, political districts and municipalities. Select a region on the map to inspect its time series in detail; the colouring shows how quickly a region is growing or shrinking.
about.intro_2: All data comes from Statistik Austria and is refreshed automatically. The site runs entirely in your browser — no data is sent to any server.
about.links_text: The full source code, including the data pipeline, is available on {repo}. Have a look at my other projects as well, such as the {transition} or the {power}.

data.title: Data sources
data.source_text: Two Statistik Austria time series underpin this site: population at the beginning of each year by administrative unit (since 2002), and population at the beginning of each quarter by Bundesland and citizenship (since 2010). Administrative boundary geometries also come from Statistik Austria and are published, like the data, under the {link} licence.
data.reference_text: All figures are stocks measured on a single reference date rather than annual averages: the annual series refers to 1 January, the quarterly series to the first day of each quarter (1 Jan, 1 Apr, 1 Jul, 1 Oct). Every update is checked automatically: totals must reconcile across all levels, and district figures are additionally cross-checked against Statistik Austria's OGD API.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.text: This site is served through GitHub Pages and uses no cookies, no tracking and no analytics. As the host, GitHub may collect access data — see {link1} and {link2}.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.text_1: This site is a private project and is not affiliated with Statistik Austria or any other public authority. The data is prepared to the best of our knowledge, but without warranty as to accuracy, completeness or timeliness.
disclaimer.text_2: For authoritative figures, please consult the original Statistik Austria sources. The most recent quarterly figures are provisional and may be revised.

ai.title: Use of AI
ai.text: Parts of this site's source code were written with the help of AI tools. The data pipeline is validated automatically against independent sources.
